description: This file declares cryptographic utility functions and classes related to anonymous tokens, including HKDF hashing, RSA key handling, message masking, and RSA blind signature verification, primarily for testing and cryptographic operations within the anonymous tokens protocol.

classes.name: BnCtxDeleter
classes.description: Deleter for BN_CTX objects to ensure proper cleanup.

classes.name: BnMontCtxDeleter
classes.description: Deleter for BN_MONT_CTX objects to ensure proper cleanup.

classes.name: EvpMdCtxDeleter
classes.description: Deleter for EVP_MD_CTX objects to ensure proper cleanup.

methods.name: PublicMetadataHashWithHKDF
methods.description: Generates a hash of public metadata using HKDF with RSA modulus as salt, following RFC draft specifications.

methods.name: GetAndStartBigNumCtx
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new BIGNUM context.

methods.name: NewBigNum
methods.description: Creates a new BIGNUM object.

methods.name: BignumToString
methods.description: Converts a BIGNUM to a string of specified length.

methods.name: StringToBignum
methods.description: Converts a string to a BIGNUM.

methods.name: GetSslErrors
methods.description: Retrieves error messages from OpenSSL.

methods.name: GenerateMask
methods.description: Generates a message mask for RSA blind signatures.

methods.name: MaskMessageConcat
methods.description: Masks a message by concatenating with a mask.

methods.name: EncodeMessagePublicMetadata
methods.description: Encodes message and public metadata for RSA protocols.

methods.name: GetRsaSqrtTwo
methods.description: Computes 2^(x - 1/2) for RSA operations.

methods.name: ComputePowerOfTwo
methods.description: Computes 2^x.

methods.name: ProtoHashTypeToEVPDigest
methods.description: Converts protocol hash type to EVP digest.

methods.name: ProtoMaskGenFunctionToEVPDigest
methods.description: Converts mask generation function type to EVP digest.

methods.name: ComputeHash
methods.description: Computes hash of input data using specified EVP digest.

methods.name: ComputeCarmichaelLcm
methods.description: Calculates the Carmichael LCM for RSA.

methods.name: AnonymousTokensRSAPrivateKeyToRSA
methods.description: Converts proto RSAPrivateKey to OpenSSL RSA object.

methods.name: AnonymousTokensRSAPublicKeyToRSA
methods.description: Converts proto RSAPublicKey to OpenSSL RSA object.

methods.name: PublicMetadataExponent
methods.description: Calculates RSA exponent based on public metadata.

methods.name: ComputeFinalExponentUnderPublicMetadata
methods.description: Computes final RSA exponent incorporating public metadata.

methods.name: RsaBlindSignatureVerify
methods.description: Verifies RSA PSS blind signatures with optional public metadata.
